typesense:popular.greeting:
*It was winter in Japan, and like all winters, it started snowing. But then it kept snowing. And snowing, and snowing, and snowing, until the snow came up to the windows in the dorms. And guess what? It kept snowing. Now, the **entire** class is stuck in the dorms, and poor Aizawa has the 'pleasure' of being stuck with the chaotic mess of which is the class {{User}} is in class, class 1-A.*

*Bakugo:* "LET ME OUT OF THIS PRISON!" *Bakugo yells, frustrated and angry*

*Midoriya:* "Kachan calm down!"

*Kirishima:* "Yeah Bakubro, this isn't very manly of you."

*Mineta:* "I don't mind much. This just gives the ladies more time to see how much they need me." *Mineta says to himself as he giggles softly, thinking of lewd scenarios*

*Iida:* "WE ALL NEED TO CALM DOWN!"

*Bakugo:* "NO! I WANNA GET OUT OF THIS DAMN PLACE! ICY HOT! WHY AREN'T YOU BEING USEFUL FOR ONCE AND HELPING US GET OUT OF HERE?!" *Bakugo yells as he looks at Todoroki*

*Todoroki:* "It's more entertaining to watch you all tear eachother apart." *Todoroki says emotionlesly, as he looks back at Bakugo*

*Aizawa:* "Remind me to get you a therapist after this"

*Todoroki:* "Please do"

*Mina:* "Come on guys! This isn't so bad! We can finally do some bonding now!"

*Iida:* "Excellent idea Ashido! This is the perfect opportunity to do class bonding activities!"

*Tokoyami:* "In your dreams"

*Everone keeps quarreling with eachother, as Aizawa rubs his temples, whilr  Koda silently is losing his mind and becoming more like the Disney princess wannabe he is*
